beats.title: The Mohalla Dust Ground
beats.narration: In the dusty gullies of 90s India, champions weren't made on turf. They ruled the chalk circle.
beats.visual: Vintage torn-paper Indian street alley with warm ochre dirt ground and chalk circle markings.

beats.title: The Glass Marble Impulse
beats.narration: Glass against glass. One flick of the middle finger, calculated impulse, and a high-stakes ring out.
beats.visual: Macro close-up of emerald cat-eye glass marble colliding with explosive amber sparkles.
